findings.review: Three parallel boats visibly support the transverse deck. Ribs, attached timber beams and lashings are coherent. No modern Bailey truss or scenery; the boat/deck silhouette reads at 48/64 pixels.
findings.limits: Generic pontoon section, not an exact reconstruction of a named crossing. Small lashings disappear at 32 pixels.

findings.review: Two wooden spoked wheels, connected chassis and shafts, pale linen hood and empty stretcher inside the rear opening. No text, red-cross emblem or blood. Transport silhouette is distinct from the boat bridge.
findings.limits: Conceptual early field ambulance, not an exact Larrey carriage facsimile. Wheel/body connections are stylized, not an engineering drawing; the stretcher is a subordinate detail at small scale.

findings.review: Masonry vault and protective earth layer are visible; cannon aims through the intact wall opening, with wooden carriage on the chamber floor. Compact cutaway clearly differs from the Vauban star fortress; no concrete bunker or modern turret.
findings.limits: Generic explanatory chamber with simplified proportions. Not a site-specific or dimensionally exact Haxo reconstruction.
